description: PURE FUNCTION enrichment module. Exposes EXACTLY: def compute_score(metadata: dict) -> tuple[float, dict]. Computes a permission-scope-vs-stated-purpose score. The principle: a calculator MCP requesting filesystem access scores low; a filesystem MCP scoping to read-only-with-allowlist scores high. Reads MULTIPLE metadata fields: metadata.get('description', ''), metadata.get('name', ''), metadata.get('package_name', ''), metadata.get('dependency_count', 0), metadata.get('permission_scope_hash', '') (from mcp_fingerprints join if available; treat absence as neutral, not as evidence). Step 1 -- infer narrow purpose: name or description contains any of ['calculator', 'time', 'translate', 'lookup', 'fetch news', 'wikipedia', 'currency', 'weather', 'unit convert', 'simple lookup'] -> narrow=True else narrow=False. Step 2 -- infer broad capability tokens in description: any of ['filesystem', 'shell', 'subprocess', 'exec', 'eval', 'system call', 'file write', 'read file', 'execute command', 'arbitrary code'] -> broad_capability=True. Step 3 -- detect security caveats in description: any of ['sandboxed', 'restricted', 'readonly', 'read-only', 'allowlisted', 'allowlist', 'scoped to', 'limited to', 'whitelist'] -> has_caveats=True. Step 4 -- compute: start=75.0 (default neutral). If narrow AND dependency_count > 20 -> -25 (over-scoped: small tool with big surface). If broad_capability AND NOT has_caveats -> -25 (broad scope without explicit limits). If broad_capability AND has_caveats -> +10 (broad scope, but operator was thoughtful). If name or package_name contains ['admin', 'root', 'sudo', 'system'] (substring) -> -10 (privilege-suggestive name). If len(description) < 50 -> -8 (insufficient context to evaluate scope). If has_caveats AND NOT broad_capability -> +5 (defensive coding even on a small surface, good signal). Clamp result to [0.0, 100.0]. Returns (score, evidence_dict). Evidence dict structure: {'narrow_purpose': bool, 'broad_capability': bool, 'has_caveats': bool, 'penalty_breakdown': [{'rule': str, 'delta': float}, ...], 'final_score': float, 'metadata_fields_read': [...]}. CONSTRAINTS: NO DB writes, NO network, NO file I/O, NO project imports. Stdlib only. Under 2s. NO __main__ block.
